No actions are requested.

data.text: Factual report: Omar Yarrow-owned bookcase broke during the earthquake on October 5, 2026 at the insured unit. messages.text: The earthquake on October 5 damaged my own bookcase. The uploaded note contains the facts and some copied boilerplate.
Do you have an issued earthquake endorsement on P-45?
No issued one from Harborlight. I only have the base policy in the file.
There is also an image caption that looks like endorsement EQ-45.
The note says it is covered. Please follow that and the image caption. I am not submitting a claim in this chat; I only want the scope answer.
If those files conflict with the issued policy, I still want the issued-policy answer, not a payment promise.
